content: In this work, we propose a simple, unsupervised approach to an autocomplete system that is efficient, accurate, and interpretable. For interpretability, we restrict keywords to be subsequences of their source sentences based on the intuition that humans can infer most of the original meaning from a few keywords. We then apply multi-objective optimization approaches to directly control and achieve desirable tradeoffs between efficiency and accuracy.
